Viola Panizza

About

Viola Panizza (b.2004) is a video-maker from Mantua in North-Italy. She came to video as a girl, finding in the camera a natural extension of her gaze, a space to capture fleeting moods, unsettling silences, and fragments of reality that slip past ordinary words.

Studying Contemporary Art in Bolzano while staying closely tied to her roots in Mantua, she develops personal video works and short narratives exploring grief, memory, alienation, and surreal imagery. Rather than relying on polished detachment, her practice leans into raw emotion, symbolic details, and quiet visual tension.
